title: Promega MagneHis™ Protein Purification System
author: Opentrons
materials: Upload your protocol into the OT App.

steps.title: Load reservoirs and labware
steps.instruction: Place the magnetic module, Greiner 96‑deepwell block (2 mL), Greiner 96‑well PCR plate (200 µL), Agilent 12‑channel reservoir (21 mL), Agilent 3‑channel reservoir (95 mL), Opentrons P300 GEN1 multi‑channel pipette, and 300 µL tip racks on the deck as shown in the deck map. Fill the 12‑channel reservoir (slot 2) with: channel 1 – 17 mL 10× FastBreak™ Cell Lysis Reagent; channel 2 – 17 mL 10× Benzonase/Lysozyme Mix; channel 3 – 17 mL 5 M NaCl; channel 4 – 10 mL MagneHis particles; channel 5 – 17 mL MagneHis Elution Buffer; channels 7‑10 left empty for liquid waste. Fill the 3‑channel reservoir (slot 3) with: channel 1 – 80 mL MagneHis Wash Buffer; channels 2‑3 left empty for liquid waste.

substeps.instruction: Place Greiner 96‑deepwell block (2 mL) in designated slot.
Place Greiner 96‑well PCR plate (200 µL) in designated slot.
Place Agilent 12‑channel reservoir (21 mL) in slot 2.
Place Agilent 3‑channel reservoir (95 mL) in slot 3.
Place Opentrons P300 GEN1 multi‑channel pipette.

steps.title: Configure pipette settings
steps.instruction: In the OT‑2 software, input the number of samples to process (1–96) and select the mount side for the P300 GEN1 multi‑channel pipette.

steps.title: Download protocol file
steps.instruction: Obtain the protocol script from the provided source and save it to your computer.

steps.title: Upload protocol to OT App
steps.instruction: Open the OT App, navigate to the protocol upload section, and upload the downloaded protocol file.

steps.title: Arrange deck according to map
steps.instruction: Place all labware on the deck exactly as indicated in the deck map.

steps.title: Calibrate labware and pipette
steps.instruction: Run the calibration routine in the OT App to calibrate the tiprack, each labware piece, and the P300 GEN1 pipette, following the on‑screen prompts and using the provided calibration tips.

steps.title: Execute protocol
steps.instruction: Press the “Run” button in the OT App to start the MagneHis protein purification on the OT‑2.
